dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, were you a good student in elementary school?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wɜːr juː ə ˈɡʊd ˈstuːdənt ɪn ˌɛləˈmɛntri ˌskuːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not always! I used to talk a lot in class.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɔːlweɪz! aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈtɔːk ə ˈlɑːt ɪn ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. One day, I drew a cat on my classmate's homework.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ, aɪ ˈdruː ə ˈkæt ɑːn maɪ ˈklæsmeɪts ˈhoʊmwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. We had a big fight, and the teacher was very angry, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wiː ˈhæd ə ˈbɪɡ ˈfaɪt, ənd ðə ˈtiːtʃər wʌz ˈvɛri ˈæŋɡri, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I used to fight with my brother every day.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈfaɪt wɪð maɪ ˈbrʌðər ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. But when we became teenagers, we stopped. Now we're good friends.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bʌt wɛn wiː bɪˈkeɪm ˈtiːneɪdʒərz, wiː ˈstɑːpt. ˈnaʊ wɪr ˈɡʊd ˈfrɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's nice. Fah and I used to fight, too. Now she's a teenager, and we're good friends, too!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈnaɪs. ˈfɑː ənd aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈfaɪt, ˈtuː. ˈnaʊ ʃiːz ə ˈtiːneɪdʒər, ənd wɪr ˈɡʊd ˈfrɛndz, ˈtuː!
